test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b85f250b6d3eb6cb7c572d29a4e4990671da424147109d5a7ad203c7b3f63f6.png]
solution:
Logic : In each figure the bottom part of the is same i.e closed figure with 2 lines and 2 curves or arc.

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/816dbe652e5ef84373200ea8fd10886f84da7770e3e84906487a510359162ce2.png] ⇒ Here the bottom part has the enclosed figure with 2 lines and 2 curves.

 
• Option - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50e32f57677245528b298b8f72f3059970febadfa1226b3d58c1d864be76c4d.png] ⇒ Here the bottom part has the enclosed figure with 2 lines and 2 curves.

 
• Option - (3) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e652f9028a303d7711ff92032bef6442fb84dd947a6e97dbaa4c72987de053d3.png] **⇒ Here the bottom part has the enclosed figure with 4 lines and 0 curves.**

 
• Option - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e41c0805f1b6ea3ff07ddf09aad1823426b5259f61f9700c91a256e6240d7154.png] ⇒ Here the bottom part has the enclosed figure with 2 lines and 2 curves.

Here, Figure - (3) is the odd one out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3b7cf5daa527d62e7df232a137c7bc45c3534dcfab3c0f79d9ce08e074e493.png] 

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
